_comment: Register of reference sources for the on-phone guide. Every item is PENDING Levi's approval (see docs/PERAZIM_AI_PROJECT/REFERENCE_SOURCE_REGISTER_2026-11-23.md). Presence here is not approval: the app only uses sources listed in src/main/assets/reference/approvals.json.

sources.title: OpenBible.info cross-references
sources.author: Stephen Smith (OpenBible.info); seeded from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge (public domain)
sources.attribution: Cross-reference data: OpenBible.info (CC BY 4.0), built from the public-domain Treasury of Scripture Knowledge.

sources.title: OpenBible.info Bible places
sources.author: OpenBible.info
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (site statement). Some coordinates derive from OpenStreetMap (ODbL): verify before release.
sources.attribution: Places data: OpenBible.info (CC BY 4.0). Some coordinates from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0).

candidates.title: Matthew Henry's Commentary on the Whole Bible
candidates.licence: Public domain (CCEL: 'Public domain. May be copied and distributed freely.')
candidates.note: Six volumes at about 6 MB text each; ship only as an optional download.

candidates.title: John Gill's Exposition of the Entire Bible
candidates.licence: Public domain (author died 1771); verify CCEL rights line
candidates.theology: Strongly Calvinist, hyper-Calvinist tendencies: sharp conflict with Arminian sources
candidates.note: Flag every use.

candidates.title: Jamieson-Fausset-Brown Commentary
candidates.note: CCEL path not confirmed in this session.

candidates.title: Albert Barnes' Notes on the Bible
candidates.note: CCEL path not confirmed in this session.

candidates.title: Adam Clarke's Commentary
candidates.note: Conflicts with Reformed commentaries; flag.

candidates.title: John Wesley's Explanatory Notes upon the New Testament
candidates.licence: Public domain (author died 1791); verify CCEL rights line
candidates.note: NT only.

candidates.title: John Calvin's Commentaries (Calvin Translation Society)
candidates.note: Large; optional.

candidates.title: Ante-Nicene Fathers (Roberts-Donaldson / Schaff ed.)

candidates.note: Ten volumes; large; optional.

candidates.title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers (Schaff ed.)
candidates.note: Large; optional.

candidates.title: Schaff, The Creeds of Christendom, vol. III (Evangelical Protestant creeds with translations)
candidates.note: Bilingual Latin and English; needs section parsing before use. Wikisource creeds used instead for now.
